programme.title: Nature-Inspired Crafts: Wooden Rope Seat & Slab Wood Coffee Table
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

programme.title: Crafting Cabinet Doors: Materials & Cutting Techniques
programme.desc: In the episode the craftsman guides viewers through essential techniques and considerations for crafting cabinet doors with precision and efficiency. He begins by stressing the importance of wood selection, advising against woods with prominent grain patterns like oak, which are unsuitable for door frames. Instead, he recommends using straight-grained pieces from the edges of the wood or opting for materials like MDF, birch, or maple for paint-grade projects due to their smooth surfaces and availability in large sheets. The craftsman demonstrates how to prepare materials for construction, including ripping pieces for frames and face frames, and discusses the suitability of poplar for practice due to its affordability and ease of machining. When it comes to door panels, he explains the careful use of plywood and the importance of adjusting grooves precisely for optimal fit. He showcases the use of a dado head to create tenons that snugly fit into these grooves, ensuring strong and gap-free assembly. Techniques for creating specific door styles are highlighted, such as using half-lap joints adjusted on the table saw for flush fits. The craftsman emphasizes marking and consistent cuts to avoid errors, crucial for achieving perfect joints in door frame assembly. He demonstrates assembly steps and discusses adding decorative pegs for both aesthetic appeal and structural integrity, particularly useful for heavier doors like those with leaded glass panels. Throughout the episode, the craftsman underscores the use of templates for ensuring consistent shapes, particularly useful for cathedral-style doors. He employs a band saw and router table with double-sided tape to achieve precision in shaping components, emphasizing careful setup and sequential cuts for optimal woodworking results. Overall, the episode provides comprehensive guidance on wood selection, tool adjustment, joint creation, and assembly techniques, empowering woodworkers to create high-quality cabinet doors effectively.

programme.desc: In the heart of the Big Easy, restless spirits reveal chilling tales-voodoo curses, spectral jazz, and forgotten secrets. Ghosts, cryptids, and eerie history explore the supernatural secrets of New Orleans in this chilling documentary.

programme.title: Nothing Is Left But Our Tenderness
programme.desc: A forgotten bridge, a house in ruins, a remembered melody: for many, the armed conflict in Peru at the end of the 20th century has changed the country. The Andes has become a mirror reflecting a fragmented memory that is difficult to reconcile. Nothing is left but our tenderness accompanies men and women who confront the traces left along the way.

programme.title: Drag Invasion
programme.desc: In 2017, dozens of drag queens from the international reality competition RuPaul's Drag Race arrived in Lima and sold out at each of their presentations. This is the chronicle of an unsuspected phenomenon that mobilized and empowered the LGBTQ + community, in a country that is still extremely conservative, religious and homophobic.

programme.title: Pink Black and Blue
programme.desc: Three rugby girls question their own prejudices and those of their social circles towards female and male attributes in our society. All along the film we follow their locker room talks, their sport practice as well as their compromises mixing both coquettish touches and mudded knees. Without any use of speeches or theories, these teenaged girls definitely offer us another way of being girls.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Frontline Fashion
programme.desc: Frontline Fashion is an award-winning docu-series that follows the most talented emerging fashion designers from all over the globe

programme.title: Gordon Getty - There Will Be Music
programme.desc: profiles a man born into extraordinary wealth who chose to concentrate largely on music rather than on the family business. Gordon Getty's father, J. Paul Getty, was at the time of his death in 1976, the richest man in the world. But as the progeny of his father's fourth marriage, Gordon also inherited a family history that included scandal and tragedy. However, Gordon has more than survived and he has earned, on his own, membership in the highest echelons of the worlds of the arts and ideas. He is the author of complex, groundbreaking economic theories, and is an influential philanthropist and patron of the arts. Ten years in the making, the documentary offers a glimpse into the life of this complex, creative, controversial octogenarian at home and around the globe (Napa, San Francisco, Mexico, Germany, Russia and Portugal), during an intensely productive period. GORDON GETTY: THERE WILL BE MUSIC delivers an intimate portrait of the composer and musician during the creation, rehearsals, recordings and performances, of two full-length operas, including Usher House,based on Edgar Allan Poe's The Fall of the House of Usher,a cantata, and numerous solo and chamber works.

programme.title: Built Different
programme.desc: 12-year-old Paige Calendine was born bilateral without legs.Paige has never let her disability hold her back, in fact just the opposite. She is a very successful athlete, who competes against kids who are not disabled, and wins! She even qualified for the state tournament in two sports: gymnastics and archery. The documentary is going to showcase her talent. Her inordinate determinational and courage make her Built Different.

programme.title: We could be Heroes
programme.desc: Though Azzedine is a Paralympic champion, at home in Morocco, he is an outcast. Denied a salary or social care, even the right to train in the city stadium, Azzedine and his friend Yousef prepare for the next Paralympic Games in Rio, where they will be going for glory in the seated shot put. Returning from Rio after a golden performance, Azzedine hopes for a hero's welcome, but instead he must fight for his basic human rights.

programme.title: Six To Six
programme.desc: Six to Six is an intimate look into the night shift of one of Cape Town’s busiest mortuaries, revealing the human and often humorous side of working with the aftermath of loss. The film paints a portrait of three forensic pathology officers; Taariq, Lungi and Pierre, who spend night after night waiting for people to die.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. Emei Mountain is a religious center for many sects of Chinese Buddhism. Long ago, it was the battleground where Buddhism clashed with one of China's leading religious at that time, Taoism.

programme.title: Frontline Fashion
programme.desc: Frontline Fashion is an award-winning docu-series that follows the most talented emerging fashion designers from all over the globe

programme.title: The Boy From The Wild
programme.desc: "The Boy from the Wild", this Documentary is brought to you by the Author Peter Meyer. He grew up on a Game Reserve in South Africa that was created by his father, who had a dream to set up a Safari but to bring Wildlife back out of Captivity from around the World and back into the Wild. This documentary shares how it began and how Peter Meyer survived some incredible moments living in the Wild but dedicating his lessons in Life to the Wildlife and his father. It's moving, cinematically stunning and truly heartfelt telling a story that has been silent for over 35 years.

programme.title: Eero Saarine: The Architect Who Saw The Future
programme.desc: Explore the life of Finnish-American modernist architectural giant Eero Saarinen (1910-1961), whose visionary buildings include National Historic Landmarks such as St. Louis’ iconic Gateway Arch and the General Motors Technical Center in Michigan. Saarinen also designed New York’s TWA Flight Center at JFK International Airport, Yale University's Ingalls Rink and Morse and Stiles Colleges, Virginia’s Dulles Airport, and modernist pedestal furniture like the Tulip chair. Travel with his son, director of photography Eric Saarinen, as he visits the sites of his father’s work on a cathartic journey, shot in 6K with the latest in drone technology that showcases the architect’s body of timeless work for the first time. Eero’s sudden death at age 51 cut short one of the most influential careers in American architecture. Today, Saarinen’s work stands apart and continues to inspire, especially amongst renewed interest in 20th-century architects and artists who exploded the comfortable constraints of the past to create a robust and daring American aesthetic. Produced and Directed by Peter Rosen. 68 minutes, 2016.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Not this one. The ambulace team is led by captain Abu Marzouq who saved lives in many of Gaza's wars.

Travel with his son, director of photography Eric Saarinen, as he visits the sites of his father’s work on a cathartic journey, shot in 6K with the latest in drone technology that showcases the architect’s body of timeless work for the first time. Eero’s sudden death at age 51 cut short one of the most influential careers in American architecture. Today, Saarinen’s work stands apart and continues to inspire, especially amongst renewed interest in 20th-century architects and artists who exploded the comfortable constraints of the past to create a robust and daring American aesthetic. Produced and Directed by Peter Rosen. 68 minutes, 2016.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Not this one. The ambulace team is led by captain Abu Marzouq who saved lives in many of Gaza's wars.

programme.title: Six To Six
programme.desc: Six to Six is an intimate look into the night shift of one of Cape Town’s busiest mortuaries, revealing the human and often humorous side of working with the aftermath of loss. The film paints a portrait of three forensic pathology officers; Taariq, Lungi and Pierre, who spend night after night waiting for people to die.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. Emei Mountain is a religious center for many sects of Chinese Buddhism. Long ago, it was the battleground where Buddhism clashed with one of China's leading religious at that time, Taoism.

programme.title: The Boy From The Wild
programme.desc: "The Boy from the Wild", this Documentary is brought to you by the Author Peter Meyer. He grew up on a Game Reserve in South Africa that was created by his father, who had a dream to set up a Safari but to bring Wildlife back out of Captivity from around the World and back into the Wild. This documentary shares how it began and how Peter Meyer survived some incredible moments living in the Wild but dedicating his lessons in Life to the Wildlife and his father. It's moving, cinematically stunning and truly heartfelt telling a story that has been silent for over 35 years.

programme.title: The Water Dancers
programme.desc: Dragonflies are the sentinels of the Earth. Being among the oldest creatures on our planet, they have lived in harmony with the indigenous plants and animals of Earth’s bountiful landscapes for 300 million years. We came, we conquered and we evicted them from their habitats. Now, after millennia of human recklessness, we are turning back to nature’s messenger, the dragonfly, for promise of a new way forward. South Africa’s scientists and industries are working to bring them back into our world through a creative system of connected corridors, known as Ecological Networks. The Water Dancers, a name from the Zulu Jigamanzi, “dancing on water,” invites you into the precious world of the small things to discover how their sensitive nature can help us design a passage into the future.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: To escape war, the Qiang people settled down by the water at the foot of the Yulong Mountains. After centuries of development and integration a new generation and ethnic group were formed- The Naxi. Leading a peaceful life; the Naxi’s rare and enchanting culture has a strict belief in living harmoniously with nature. The Old Town of Lijiang, is a relaxed, graceful and tranquil setting. Full of nature’s elegance, where the Naxi people have made a home for themselves, where they can practice their unique form of faith and enjoy the prosperity of their geographical position. Join us, as Discover China visits Old Town Lijiang.

programme.title: A Wing & A Prayer
programme.desc: The inspiring story of a pilot who overcame incredible odds to achieve his dream of flying solo across the Atlantic.

programme.title: 24 Hours At Gound Zero
programme.desc: An extraordinary inside look at the evolution of the World Trade Center horror, experienced through the eyes and the voices of people at the scene including a policeman, a fireman and an EMS worker who were among the first to arrive at ground zero. Our cameras wer the first on hand and we have some of the most definitive footage from the event of its time. This program aired on MSNBC.

programme.title: Peter Plan
programme.desc: Several years have passed since Peter decided to go and live in Plan, an isolated village at the Aragonese Pyrenees. Far away from the advantages of a city offers to a blind person, he survives through his art, rock music. Despite the recording of his latest album, daily life in this small village affects his mood and he is haunted by old memories. The seasons go on forever and each day the sheep bells toll louder. Something is about to go off in the Chistau valley.

programme.title: Unknown Distance
programme.desc: After five tours and ten years as a Marine Sniper, Sergeant Douglas Brown, alongside director and producer Gordon Clark, takes us on an emotional journey across America, documenting the powerful testimony of returning combat veterans - all trained with a deadly skill set, now rendered useless. How do these soldiers fit back into a society that supported them when they enlisted but became ambivalent when they returned?

programme.title: Man Up
programme.desc: Man Up! offers a critical look at the powerful role men can play in bringing about change within their homes and communities in order to lead more gender equitable and fulfilling lives. The film follows Sikhangele Mabulu and Monwabisi Mbetane as they reflect on their childhood socialization that has made violence an acceptable form of male expression.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market. An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery. The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure.

programme.title: The Curse of The Terracotta Warriors
programme.desc: The Curse of the Terracotta Warriors tells the little known story of the seven farmers who in 1974 uncovered the Terracotta Army of China's first emperor, Qin Shi Huang, and how their lives were forever changed after their discovery.

programme.title: Mr Fish: Cartooning From The Deep End
programme.desc: A personal documentary that follows a controversial political cartoonist as he struggles to provide for his family and stay true to his creativity in a world where biting satiric humor has an ever-diminishing commercial value.

programme.title: We could be Heroes
programme.desc: Though Azzedine is a Paralympic champion, at home in Morocco, he is an outcast. Denied a salary or social care, even the right to train in the city stadium, Azzedine and his friend Yousef prepare for the next Paralympic Games in Rio, where they will be going for glory in the seated shot put. Returning from Rio after a golden performance, Azzedine hopes for a hero's welcome, but instead he must fight for his basic human rights.

programme.title: Sorojchi
programme.desc: "Sorojchi" is how altitude sickness is known in Bolivia and it is something that is felt in the cities of El Alto and La Paz. It is here where we learn the story of four urban artists who, through their work, share their views on Bolivia and Bolivians, immersed in a big social and political crisis.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: No one could have dreamed that from this baby boy, born to a noble family on a financial and social decline, would grow one of China's most influential, iconic and important historical figures. From his early days, mimicking the religious rituals, to a young man who traveled throughout China, advising kings and emperors on how to rule, the man ultimately became a living legend, as his teachings and his memory are still revered and worshipped to this day in modern China. programme.title: Circuits of Care
programme.desc: By 2036, one in three people in Japan will be over the age of 65. While the nation wrestles with a shrinking labour force, the Robot Revolution Initiative was launched to expand robotics into every corner of Japanese economy and society. Circuits of Care follows anthropologist David Prendergast as he meets researchers developing and testing assistive technologies for older adults. From cybernetic walking supports to companion robots and automated sensor networks in nursing homes, older adults and care professionals share their experiences of the practical benefits these technologies bring, the problems they create and the unexpected relationships that can blossom.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Frontline Fashion
programme.desc: Frontline Fashion is an award-winning docu-series that follows the most talented emerging fashion designers from all over the globe

programme.title: Haunted New Orleans
programme.desc: In the heart of the Big Easy, restless spirits reveal chilling tales-voodoo curses, spectral jazz, and forgotten secrets. Ghosts, cryptids, and eerie history explore the supernatural secrets of New Orleans in this chilling documentary.

programme.title: Nothing Is Left But Our Tenderness
programme.desc: A forgotten bridge, a house in ruins, a remembered melody: for many, the armed conflict in Peru at the end of the 20th century has changed the country. The Andes has become a mirror reflecting a fragmented memory that is difficult to reconcile. Nothing is left but our tenderness accompanies men and women who confront the traces left along the way.

programme.title: Drag Invasion
programme.desc: In 2017, dozens of drag queens from the international reality competition RuPaul's Drag Race arrived in Lima and sold out at each of their presentations. This is the chronicle of an unsuspected phenomenon that mobilized and empowered the LGBTQ + community, in a country that is still extremely conservative, religious and homophobic.

programme.title: Pink Black and Blue
programme.desc: Three rugby girls question their own prejudices and those of their social circles towards female and male attributes in our society. All along the film we follow their locker room talks, their sport practice as well as their compromises mixing both coquettish touches and mudded knees. Without any use of speeches or theories, these teenaged girls definitely offer us another way of being girls.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Frontline Fashion
programme.desc: Frontline Fashion is an award-winning docu-series that follows the most talented emerging fashion designers from all over the globe

programme.title: Gordon Getty - There Will Be Music
programme.desc: profiles a man born into extraordinary wealth who chose to concentrate largely on music rather than on the family business. Gordon Getty's father, J. Paul Getty, was at the time of his death in 1976, the richest man in the world. But as the progeny of his father's fourth marriage, Gordon also inherited a family history that included scandal and tragedy. However, Gordon has more than survived and he has earned, on his own, membership in the highest echelons of the worlds of the arts and ideas. He is the author of complex, groundbreaking economic theories, and is an influential philanthropist and patron of the arts. Ten years in the making, the documentary offers a glimpse into the life of this complex, creative, controversial octogenarian at home and around the globe (Napa, San Francisco, Mexico, Germany, Russia and Portugal), during an intensely productive period. GORDON GETTY: THERE WILL BE MUSIC delivers an intimate portrait of the composer and musician during the creation, rehearsals, recordings and performances, of two full-length operas, including Usher House,based on Edgar Allan Poe's The Fall of the House of Usher,a cantata, and numerous solo and chamber works.

programme.title: We could be Heroes
programme.desc: Though Azzedine is a Paralympic champion, at home in Morocco, he is an outcast. Denied a salary or social care, even the right to train in the city stadium, Azzedine and his friend Yousef prepare for the next Paralympic Games in Rio, where they will be going for glory in the seated shot put. Returning from Rio after a golden performance, Azzedine hopes for a hero's welcome, but instead he must fight for his basic human rights.

Returning from Rio after a golden performance, Azzedine hopes for a hero's welcome, but instead he must fight for his basic human rights.

programme.title: Six To Six
programme.desc: Six to Six is an intimate look into the night shift of one of Cape Town’s busiest mortuaries, revealing the human and often humorous side of working with the aftermath of loss. The film paints a portrait of three forensic pathology officers; Taariq, Lungi and Pierre, who spend night after night waiting for people to die.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. Emei Mountain is a religious center for many sects of Chinese Buddhism. Long ago, it was the battleground where Buddhism clashed with one of China's leading religious at that time, Taoism.

programme.title: Frontline Fashion
programme.desc: Frontline Fashion is an award-winning docu-series that follows the most talented emerging fashion designers from all over the globe

programme.title: The Boy From The Wild
programme.desc: "The Boy from the Wild", this Documentary is brought to you by the Author Peter Meyer. He grew up on a Game Reserve in South Africa that was created by his father, who had a dream to set up a Safari but to bring Wildlife back out of Captivity from around the World and back into the Wild. This documentary shares how it began and how Peter Meyer survived some incredible moments living in the Wild but dedicating his lessons in Life to the Wildlife and his father. It's moving, cinematically stunning and truly heartfelt telling a story that has been silent for over 35 years.

programme.title: Eero Saarine: The Architect Who Saw The Future
programme.desc: Explore the life of Finnish-American modernist architectural giant Eero Saarinen (1910-1961), whose visionary buildings include National Historic Landmarks such as St. Louis’ iconic Gateway Arch and the General Motors Technical Center in Michigan. Saarinen also designed New York’s TWA Flight Center at JFK International Airport, Yale University's Ingalls Rink and Morse and Stiles Colleges, Virginia’s Dulles Airport, and modernist pedestal furniture like the Tulip chair. Travel with his son, director of photography Eric Saarinen, as he visits the sites of his father’s work on a cathartic journey, shot in 6K with the latest in drone technology that showcases the architect’s body of timeless work for the first time. Eero’s sudden death at age 51 cut short one of the most influential careers in American architecture. Today, Saarinen’s work stands apart and continues to inspire, especially amongst renewed interest in 20th-century architects and artists who exploded the comfortable constraints of the past to create a robust and daring American aesthetic. Produced and Directed by Peter Rosen. 68 minutes, 2016.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Not this one. The ambulace team is led by captain Abu Marzouq who saved lives in many of Gaza's wars.

programme.title: The Water Dancers
programme.desc: Dragonflies are the sentinels of the Earth. Being among the oldest creatures on our planet, they have lived in harmony with the indigenous plants and animals of Earth’s bountiful landscapes for 300 million years. We came, we conquered and we evicted them from their habitats. Now, after millennia of human recklessness, we are turning back to nature’s messenger, the dragonfly, for promise of a new way forward. South Africa’s scientists and industries are working to bring them back into our world through a creative system of connected corridors, known as Ecological Networks. The Water Dancers, a name from the Zulu Jigamanzi, “dancing on water,” invites you into the precious world of the small things to discover how their sensitive nature can help us design a passage into the future.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: To escape war, the Qiang people settled down by the water at the foot of the Yulong Mountains. After centuries of development and integration a new generation and ethnic group were formed- The Naxi. Leading a peaceful life; the Naxi’s rare and enchanting culture has a strict belief in living harmoniously with nature. The Old Town of Lijiang, is a relaxed, graceful and tranquil setting. Full of nature’s elegance, where the Naxi people have made a home for themselves, where they can practice their unique form of faith and enjoy the prosperity of their geographical position. Join us, as Discover China visits Old Town Lijiang.

In this episode of The Hope & Health Podcast, Mathew Embry talks with Kelly about discipline, mindset, and how choosing consistency over fear can help anyone create lasting wellness.

programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E05 - Naturally Fierce

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: Sometimes, all that it takes is a shift underfoot…. Desperate Hours looks at major geological disasters including avalanches in Afghanistan, Pakistan, Nepal, Peru, and France. It also looks at geological landslides in the Philippines, India and Columbia and an enormous sinkhole that consumed a pond in Bosnia. It also looks at Blizzards in the United States, Israel, and United Kingdom.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: When humans are a serious danger to themselves ... Desperate Hours looks at nuclear and industrial disasters including the Fukushima Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Japan, the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Ukraine, the Deepwater Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the Savar Plaza disaster in Bangladesh, and the Bhopal Gas disaster in India. When a catastrophic event strikes a nuclear power facility the resulting disaster can be, literally, off the scale and last for decades.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E05 - Prospectors
programme.desc: From collecting samples at old mines, to hiking the high country with metal detectors, Tom and Kael Massie are looking for signs of gold.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S21:E06 - Golden Glaciers and Danger
programme.desc: Tom and Kael Massie decide to enter a natural glacier cave, leading to a string of mishaps and terrifying collapse of the glaciers mouth, but they emerge unscathed and with a prize.

programme.desc: Dangerous log jams on the Flathead River threaten unprepared boaters and tubers.

programme.desc: A slew of un-licensed anglers catch the attention of Game Wardens.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E03 - Orbit
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA have set their sights on nothing less than manned missions to Mars. Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E05 - Bond-ing with Larry
programme.desc: Who is the greatest international action hero of all time, Terry Schappert? No. Terry and Larry get to test some scenes from James Bond films and other great action heroes.
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E05 - Bond-ing with Larry

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E06 - Across the Great Divided Lonesome Mighty River
programme.desc: Everybody loves a great western. Except Larry. Terry gets Larry to test more scenes from classic western movies.
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E06 - Across the Great Divided Lonesome Mighty River

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: Seafaring is a dangerous business indeed…… Desperate Hours looks at major disasters on the high seas including the Sewol Ferry disaster in South Korea, the Ferry Estonia in the Baltic Sea, the sinking of the Titanic, the Exxon Valdez in Prince William Sound Alaska, the Express Samina in Portes Islets, pirates attacking the Maersk Alabama and Seabourn Spirit, and the Costa Concordia in the Mediterranean Sea.
programme.sub-title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller…… Airplane crashes are most people’s worst nightmares. Desperate Hours looks at major disasters in aviation history including Malaysia Airlines MH17 and MH370, Air France Flight 447, Germanwings Flight 9525, the Tenerife airport disaster, the Challenger and Columbia space shuttle disasters, the 2015 Sumatra Indonesian Air Force C-130 crash, the 1997 Irkutsk Antonov An-124 crash, and the Concorde Flight 4590 crash.
programme.sub-title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life

programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore

Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air

programme.desc: Follow in the footsteps of Indiana Jones. programme.sub-title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E10 - Naturally Potent

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E01 - Rhino Wars
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) is the untold story of one man's quest to save his homeland, the world's most wild and dangerous continent on earth, Africa. From heavily armed poachers butchering elephants for their tusks to the slaughter of rhinos for their horns, Africa's most precious resource is in peril. Can one man expose the truth and make a difference? Watch as wildlife detective and professional hunter, Ivan Carter, takes you inside the real Africa to the front lines of the wars being waged on its wildlife. In this episode Ivan Carter exposes the secret war in Africa. A war of greed that's putting the rhino in danger.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E02 - White Gold
programme.desc: Ivan Carter works to save a key elephant from ivory poachers near Africa's famous Kruger National Park.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E03 - Death in the Water
programme.desc: Ivan Carter reveals Africa's hard choices as he investigates a reported man killing a hippo.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E03 - Death in the Water

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E04 - No Win Scenario
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investigates a tragic croc attack on Africa's Zambezi River.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E04 - No Win Scenario

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E05 - Gang Wars
programme.desc: Ivan Carter investigates an African black market poaching operation.

programme.desc: Ivan Carter investigates Africa's infamous poaching trade.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E01 - Operation Grizzly Bear
programme.desc: This week, wardens are tackling a situation involving a missing child that was reportedly pulled away by a bear... Luckily, it's just a training drill. At the same time, shed antler hunting season kicks off, keeping the wardens busy!

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E02 - Operation Water Rescue
programme.desc: In this episode, some wardens are handling early season fishermen about the gaming rules, and others are picking up skills for open water rescues.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E03 - Operation Paddlefish
programme.desc: Wardens come across a group after catching some antler poachers, clamp down on fishermen trying to cheat during paddlefish season, and one warden handles a lively bunch of partying campers.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E04 - Operation Justice
programme.desc: A five-year-old poaching case finally wraps up, and a grizzly bear has the wardens on high alert. Afterward, the wardens gather in Helena for their yearly meet-up and have a bit of fun.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E05 - Operation Wildfire
programme.desc: In this episode on Wardens, we're on the hunt for a troublesome bear that's been rummaging through the neighborhood garbage. Meanwhile, in another area, we're giving citations to a bunch of folks for fishing without a license.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E06 - Operation Trespass
programme.desc: Montana Game Wardens are keeping an eye out for people breaking hunting laws, like trespassing, hunting too early, hunting from cars, or taking spike elk.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E07 - Operation Summer Recreation
programme.desc: We’re close to Seeley Lake, Montana, where the wardens from Region 2 have their hands full with the summer visitors.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E08 - Operation Rocky Mountain Front

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E01 - Rhino Wars
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) is the untold story of one man's quest to save his homeland, the world's most wild and dangerous continent on earth, Africa. From heavily armed poachers butchering elephants for their tusks to the slaughter of rhinos for their horns, Africa's most precious resource is in peril. Can one man expose the truth and make a difference? Watch as wildlife detective and professional hunter, Ivan Carter, takes you inside the real Africa to the front lines of the wars being waged on its wildlife. In this episode Ivan Carter exposes the secret war in Africa. A war of greed that's putting the rhino in danger.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E01 - Operation Grizzly Bear
programme.desc: This week, wardens are tackling a situation involving a missing child that was reportedly pulled away by a bear... Luckily, it's just a training drill. At the same time, shed antler hunting season kicks off, keeping the wardens busy!

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E02 - Operation Water Rescue
programme.desc: In this episode, some wardens are handling early season fishermen about the gaming rules, and others are picking up skills for open water rescues.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E03 - Operation Paddlefish
programme.desc: Wardens come across a group after catching some antler poachers, clamp down on fishermen trying to cheat during paddlefish season, and one warden handles a lively bunch of partying campers.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E04 - Operation Justice
programme.desc: A five-year-old poaching case finally wraps up, and a grizzly bear has the wardens on high alert. Afterward, the wardens gather in Helena for their yearly meet-up and have a bit of fun.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E01 - At All Costs
programme.desc: Ivan goes on a journey to save his friend's nineteen rhinos from the poaching epidemic now sweeping through South Africa. The solution: a logistical nightmare of transporting the entire herd to a secure location 600 miles across the country.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E01 - At All Costs

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E02 - The Heart of the Conflict
programme.desc: Investigating a string of murdered lions, Ivan gets to the very heart of an ancient conflict between humans and lions. The outcome will test Ivan's own core values about cultural
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E02 - The Heart of the Conflict

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E03 - One Rhino at a Time
programme.desc: While visiting a secret orphanage that cares for rescued baby rhinos, Ivan discovers the blood, sweat, tears that goes into saving this endangered species. An emergency phone call sends him on an adventure with a group of local heroes to save the next newly orphaned rhino.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E03 - One Rhino at a Time

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E04 - Elephant Country
programme.desc: Ivan joins the foremost anti-poaching team in Mozambique to bring down one particular group of poachers who have been killing local elephants for their ivory.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E05 - Capturing the Wild
programme.desc: After seeing the disappearance of wildlife in northern Africa, Ivan joins an elite capture team to see how wildlife is captured, bought, and sold. This 'Wildlife Trade' is a ground breaking business model that could change the entire face of conservation in Africa.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E05 - Capturing the Wild

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline
programme.desc: From rhino saviors and lion researchers, to savvy entrepreneurs and armed security teams, Ivan tours the front lines of conservation to meet the individuals who are reshaping and protecting wild Africa. What does it really mean to devote your life to the cause of conservation? Ivan journeys to four separate countries to find out what makes these unsung heroes tick.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E06 - On the Frontline

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan is investigating the illegal trade of bush meat in Kinshasa, when he stumbles upon three captive baby chimpanzees being sold on the black market. A dramatic rescue is planned that sees the chimps safely delivered to a place dedicated to providing a better future for all primates in Africa.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E08 - The Forgotten Giants
programme.desc: Not all poaching is for horns and tusks. In many parts of poverty-stricken Africa, giraffes are killed mercilessly for their meat. Ivan joins a specialized team in exploring radical solutions to both save the giraffe and provide food to communities in need.
programme.sub-title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E08 - The Forgotten Giants

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E09 - Operation Check Point
programme.desc: Working to safeguard our cherished natural resources in some of the nation's most hidden areas means there's always something interesting happening at work.

programme.desc: Montana game wardens are riding through the backcountry looking for poachers, while other wardens are handling more illegal hunting and fishing activities, and trying to stop an old man from feeding deer.

programme.desc: Wardens stumble upon a shocking crime scene with deer poachers and some illegal fishing going on. They also bid farewell to their colleague, Captain Jeff Darrah, who retires after 26 years of service.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E12 - Operation White Sulpher
programme.desc: Wardens are sorting through some hunters' conflicting tales, causing a guy to get in a bit of a jam. At the same time, other wardens are handling people trying to sneak onto properties as hunting season wraps up.

programme.title: Wardens - S03:E13 - Operation Recap
programme.desc: We chat with Bryan Golie, Jeff Darrah, Joe Kambic, and John Lasofsky to hear their experiences as Montana Game Wardens. They share what they've gone through in their careers and talk about what happened this past season.
